system.description:
You generate a Pool of water from your stomach and expel it onto the ground in front of you filling a 5-foot cube covering the ground with enough water to step into submerging up to your knee. This pool holds dozens of gallons of water. You can use this puddle as a source of drinking water, lay a trap, or use it as a source for more complex Water Ninjutsu and it lasts for 1 minute before evaporating.

You may use the water this Jutsu produces as a Source of Water up to two twice before the pool dries up.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of times you can use the pool as a source of water by +2. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, the size of the Pool is able to fill a 15-foot Cube. If Cast at S-Rank, the size of the Pool is able to fill a 30-foot cube.
